items.title: Why a Former AI Executive Changed Her Career to Help Young Workers
items.summary: Clara Shih helped build AI systems at Salesforce and Meta. But as she saw the impact of the technology on young workers, she decided to take her career in a different direction to help those being displaced by AI. She spoke with Poppy Harlow at the WSJ Leadership Institute Board of Directors Summit in Palm Beach, Florida.

items.title: Salesforce (CRM) Stock Looks Undervalued Even As Leverage Concerns Linger

This leaves a straightforward question for you as an investor: Is the current US$214.94 price tag adequately supported by the earnings power of the underlying business? items.title: Clara Shih and Joe Jimenez on AI and Leadership | WSJ Leadership Institute
items.summary: Joe Jimenez, who is on the board of GM and Procter & Gamble, and Clara Shih, New Work Foundation founder, discuss AI's disruptive impact on the workforce and how corporate leaders should proactively think about how to democratize the technology and prevent widening inequality.

items.title: Salesforce Sinks as S&P Cuts Its Rating to A on Deals and a $25 Billion Buyback
items.summary: Key TakeawaysS&P cut Salesforce’s credit rating to A from A+ last week, citing rising acquisition activity and shareholder returns, while keeping a stable outlook. Salesforce agreed to buy Braze for about $5.

items.title: Is Salesforce a Falling Knife Or Is The Worst Over?
items.summary: Salesforce's AI business is growing at triple-digit rates, yet the stock keeps sliding on fears that a chatbot could replace it. Bulls and bears read the same earnings very differently, and the next two quarters will decide who is right.
